color: small red highlights only for risk boundary or warning

content_density.policy: Judge sufficiency and overload by page role; retain necessary evidence and relationships. Example label lengths are not limits.
content_density.speaker_notes_policy: Explanatory prose belongs in notes; essential visible evidence remains on the page.

whole_page_requirements: state that the output is a complete 16:9 PPT slide page image
include the full page background, title, visual structure, arrows, labels, and whitespace
avoid asking for separate icons, UI parts, sticker packs, or isolated diagram elements
medical_boundary_defaults: Do not imply a research workspace is the medical meta-agent platform itself.
Do not imply a single disease model is directly copied to another disease.
High-risk clinical or governance nodes must visibly keep human handoff.

style_reference_policy.override_semantics: Current user instructions and accepted visual direction replace example palette, lettering, material, language and forbidden aesthetic choices; reference roles constrain what may be borrowed.
style_reference_policy.repo_vendor_policy: Do not vendor external reference images into the repo. Use manifest metadata and hashes for benchmark fixtures.

selection_policy: Use only when consistent with the current brief; current user intent and accepted visual direction replace all aesthetic and language choices.
